headline: Multi-Front Escalation Grips Middle East as Ukraine War Enters Trillion-Dollar Phase
subheadline: Yemeni forces struck Mokha port vessels while Israeli operations intensified around southern Lebanon's Ali al-Taher area.
lede: The Middle East witnessed simultaneous escalations across multiple theaters as Yemeni Ansar Allah forces struck two vessels at Mokha port following attacks on Saudi-backed positions. Israeli forces conducted artillery shelling and air operations around Ali al-Taher in southern Lebanon, attempting advances with smoke cover. Meanwhile, former President Trump declared intent to designate the Strait of Hormuz as US territory, claiming Iran's air fleet eliminated. The IDF confirmed elimination of Hamas company commander Muhammad Mashtaha, who held multiple hostages in northern Gaza.

sections.title: Ukraine Reports Trillion in War Losses
sections.body: Ukraine announced losses exceeding $1 trillion from Russian aggression, establishing a compensation fund to address damages. Seven drones attacked Moscow with reports of fires in the area, while Ukrainian aircraft intercepted Russian drones over Odessa region. Russian oil exports from Black Sea terminals dropped 80% in May due to Ukrainian attacks. Missile threats from Russia's T-22M3 bombers pose elevated risk to Kyiv and surrounding areas.

sections.title: Regional Conflicts Intensify Across Theaters
sections.body: Yemeni armed forces targeted Mokha port again, burning two ships after striking Saudi-backed forces' gathering point and weapons depot. Israeli forces attempted advance toward Ali al-Taher with artillery cover and air support, throwing smoke bombs heavily around the area. Trump stated he will soon declare Strait of Hormuz US territory to prevent Iranian activities, claiming Iran's 212 aircraft are now gone. IDF eliminated Hamas company commander Muhammad Mashtaha in northern Gaza on July 30, 2026, who held multiple hostages including Ziv Berman and Omri Miran.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous escalation in Yemen's Red Sea operations, Israeli-Lebanese border clashes, and Trump's Strait of Hormuz declaration creates a multi-axis pressure campaign against Iran and its proxies. Ansar Allah's demonstrated ability to strike maritime targets at Mokha port threatens Gulf shipping lanes while Israeli operations in southern Lebanon test Hezbollah's response thresholds. The IDF's elimination of a senior Hamas commander holding hostages signals continued intelligence-driven targeting in Gaza despite ceasefire frameworks.
